title: Burst cherry tomatoes with eggs, halloumi and toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a simple staple: halloumi, eggs, vegetables, bread, oil and vinegar.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including the halloumi and the bag of spinach, is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large lidded frying pan and a toaster, and the egg-in-hollow technique suits a confident beginner.

works.reason: 500g tomatoes, 200g spinach, four eggs and 225g halloumi with toast is a sensible amount for four, and the timings will give set whites and runny yolks.

honest_times.reason: About 18 minutes of hob time plus slicing the garlic and halloumi fits within the 25 minutes printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient is used in the steps, nothing unlisted appears, and 'Wholemeal bread' matches the bread id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Mid-July cherry tomatoes are the base of the dish, not a garnish, and a quick pan breakfast suits summer.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, homely British English with helpful cues such as going easy on salt because of the halloumi.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, halloumi, spinach, tomatoes and wholemeal toast make a filling, balanced breakfast a family would happily repeat.
